data.description:
## Context / Problem

The scheduled **Test Suite (mirror)** leg `sweep (py3.14t)` (free-threaded CPython 3.14, unlocked `uv pip install '.[dev,reviewbot,ui]'`, `-n 4 --dist worksteal`) fails `tests/unit/test_mcp_drain_signing_iguanodon.py::test_close_reaching_signing_after_the_server_stops_ends_certified` in both scheduled runs checked:

- run 41696793491 (2026-11-03 18:45 UTC): the 7th failure beside the 6 review-bot failures fixed by `vegetarian-rainy-darwinsfox`.
- run 41749721339 (2026-11-04 00:45 UTC, main `c6f116f1ae8`): the only failure (1 failed, 20485 passed). In the same run, py3.14, py3.15 and the macOS full suite pass it.

Assertion: a close in flight when the server stops ends `{'signed': False, 'cause': 'sign_failed'}` with "the bound op-cert key '/tmp/rebar-opcert-<random>/opcert-key' does not exist (the composed signer's key copy is absent)".

## Hypotheses (unproven)

- The signer's temporary key copy is removed by server-shutdown cleanup before the in-flight close reaches signing, and only free-threaded scheduling makes that order observable.
- Another test on the same worker cleans up `rebar-opcert-*` temp dirs that this test's signer still uses.

## Next check

Reproduce under a free-threaded 3.14 interpreter, first with the module alone and then with that worker's test order, to tell the two hypotheses apart.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A deterministic local reproduction is recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it.
data.title: py3.14t sweep: drain-signing close loses op-cert key
